description: Build and run AI agents and workflows visually, with any model and tool.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-12: a real install of Langflow 1.12.1, upstream's current release proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data and generated credentials intact, and removes everything it created. Local Store wrote this definition from the project's own deployment instructions.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Generates 1 credential of its own, keeps it beside the app's data, and reuses it if you reinstall.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Written by Local Store from the project's own deployment instructions, not taken from an app store.
Opens without a login, in Langflow's automatic single-user mode: anyone who can reach the address can edit and run your flows.
Flows can run Python code and call external services with keys you store in it; stored keys are encrypted with a key Local Store generated for this install.

config.content:
{
  "id": "langflow",
  "name": "Langflow",
  "version": "1.12.1",
  "source": "https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow",
  "website": "https://www.langflow.org",
  "documentation": "https://docs.langflow.org/deployment-docker",
  "short_desc": "Build and run AI agents and workflows visually, with any model and tool.",
  "categories": [
    "Artificial Intelligence"
  ],
  "license": "MIT",
  "form_fields": [
    {
      "type": "text",
      "label": "Username",
      "min": 3,
      "max": 40,
      "required": true,
      "default": "langflow",
      "env_variable": "LANGFLOW_USERNAME"
    },
    {
      "type": "password",
      "label": "Password",
      "min": 8,
      "max": 80,
      "required": true,
      "env_variable": "LANGFLOW_PASSWORD"
    },
    {
      "type": "random",
      "label": "Encryption key for stored credentials",
      "min": 48,
      "max": 48,
      "env_variable": "LANGFLOW_SECRET_KEY"
    }
  ]
}
